import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3 + p[4]*t*A**p[5]
            + p[6]*t**2 + p[7]*t**3 + p[8]*np.exp(-p[9]*t)*A**2)
